decisions.statement: The session record is at one fixed path in the home directory.
The session file is written with mode 0600.
A session file with an unrecognised field parses as null.
XCUITest reports the app's WKWebView under the bundle id process-App.
The banner-tap capabilities are the sim capabilities with the bundle id dropped.

definition: the state of the one live sim session, persisted to a file in the home directory
